items.title: Why Open Access Publishing Boosts Your AI Research Citation Count
items.snippet: ## Why Open Access Publishing Boosts Your AI Research Citation Count. Open acces...
items.raw_snippet: ## Why Open Access Publishing Boosts Your AI Research Citation Count. Open access publishing — particularly in peer-reviewed, indexed journals like *Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AAIML)* — has been consistently shown to increase citation rates, expand the global reach of your research, and in 2026, it's no longer just a strategic choice. For many researchers in the **USA and Europe**, it's a **funding requirement**. * **Gold Open Access:** Your article is published directly in an open access journal. It's immediately free to all readers. This is the model AAIML follows. * **Green Open Access:** You publish in a traditional journal but self-archive a version of your paper in an open repository. That means if you're a researcher in Germany, France, the Netherlands, Sweden, or anywhere else in the EU receiving Horizon Europe funding, publishing in a Gold Open Access journal like AAIML isn't optional — it's the only compliant path.

items.title: What Is an AI Data Pipeline? | IBM
items.snippet: # What is an AI data pipeline? #### An AI data pipeline is a system for ingestin...
items.raw_snippet: # What is an AI data pipeline? #### An AI data pipeline is a system for ingesting, transforming and continuously delivering data for the development, training and deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) models. Modern AI data pipelines are designed to ingest and quickly process large and diverse volumes of data to support AI demands for data freshness. AI tools and agentic AI data engineering can help accelerate and streamline key processes in AI data pipelines—in other words, organizations can use AI to help operationalize and optimize AI itself. Traditional data pipelines were designed for the processing and storage of structured data, often through predictable workloads scheduled for batch processing at routine intervals. In the event that traditional pipelines are used to deliver data to AI models, data staleness, poor data quality and other issues can impede model performance. AI data pipelines provide that architecture, with capabilities and features tailored for the demands of AI models and AI-powered applications.
